note: Switch "libyaCrossing" (test 5, docs/council/2026-11-27-abroad.md Spec 3, thread 48): a what-if. No army of Syracuse crossed to Libya in 398 to 395; Agathocles did in 310 (Diodorus book 20) and Regulus in 256 (Polybius 1.26 to 1.34). The places and the pattern are history (card docs/research/libya-what-if.md); the steps between places, the rolls and every number are invention. The places are shown as a list, not drawn on a map, until positions are checked against a saved source.
whatIf: Dionysius never did this. Agathocles did, in 310 BC.

places.name: the Quarries
places.detail: The beach where Agathocles landed and made his camp (Diodorus 20.6.3).

places.name: Megalepolis
places.detail: A rich town amid villas, vines and gardens, stormed and plundered (Diodorus 20.8.2 to 20.8.6).

places.name: White Tunis
places.detail: Agathocles took it, and later kept his camp and a garrison near it (Diodorus 20.8.7, 20.17.1).

places.name: Neapolis
places.detail: The first of the coast towns, taken by storm (Diodorus 20.17.1).

places.name: Hadrumetum
places.detail: A coast town that surrendered to Agathocles in fright (Diodorus 20.17.5).

places.name: Utica
places.detail: A walled city that deserted Agathocles and was stormed in 307 (Diodorus 20.54 to 20.55).

places.name: Carthage
places.detail: The city itself: its walls made it safe from siege (Diodorus 20.59.2). It fell only in 146 BC.

choices.label: Beach the ships
choices.note: The fleet stays at the Quarries: your way home, but Carthage's ships may fall on it on the beach.

choices.label: Burn the ships as a vow
choices.note: +1 in battle while the vow holds: "in victory alone would they have hope of safety". You cannot sail home without new ships.

answers.name: Recall the army from Sicily
answers.line: Send to Sicily and bring the army home: the city comes first.
answers.source: they sent to Hamilcar "begging him to send aid as soon as possible" (Diodorus 20.15.1)

answers.name: Arm the citizens
answers.line: Arm the citizens and march out against him ourselves.
answers.source: "they led the citizen soldiers themselves into the field" (Diodorus 20.10.5)

answers.name: Strike Syracuse while he is away
answers.line: Leave him in Libya and take his city while he is gone.
